title: Tree of a Thousand Stars
description: Oil on canvas, 24x36 inches. Inspired by the golden hour light of the Pacific Northwest. This piece captures the fleeting moment when the sun dips below the mountain ridge, casting warm amber tones across the valley floor.

title: Bouquet and Sea
description:
Oil on canvas, 18x24 inches. A bouquet in a clear glass vase, painted before a sea-like background.
This work marks my return to oil painting more than three decades after art school.

title: Not Cézanne
description:
Oil on canvas, 30x40 inches. An apple painting that accidentally echoes Cézanne.
It is not Cézanne.

title: 엄마 아님
description: Oil on canvas, 20x30 inches. A portrait of my mother, rendered with an excess of flesh, affection, and honesty—ultimately unsuitable as a gift.

title: Autumn Reverie
description: Oil on canvas, 16x20 inches. Capturing the vibrant transformation of fall foliage, this piece celebrates the rich oranges, reds, and yellows of the season against a cool blue sky.
